title: observability: token-kv metrics & tracing dashboard + alert tuning
author: Priya Menon
description:
Context: Several customers and internal canaries showed unexplained variance in per-token cost and KV cache hit behavior under tail workloads. Existing dashboards surface aggregate token cost and latency but do not tie KV cache behavior and tracing spans to alerting. This PR adds token-KV specific metrics, a combined metrics+tracing dashboard, and tuned alert rules to reduce noisy paging alerts and catch regressions earlier.

What I changed: consolidated into a single PR to make rollout easier for Dedicated and Hosted monitoring stacks. Changes include: (1) new Prometheus metrics for KV lookup counts, KV cache hit/miss per-model and per-route; (2) tracing spans for the KV lookup path and end-to-end token generation path to correlate slow KV lookups with token latency spikes; (3) a Grafana dashboard JSON that shows token-level cost/latency breakdowns, KV hit-rate heatmaps, and tracing links; (4) tuned alert thresholds and added a multi-window alert policy to prevent noisy alerts during brief load spikes; (5) docs describing the dashboard and recommended runbooks.

Why: This enables SRE and product teams to diagnose token-latency regressions faster and attribute cost increases to KV cache behavior vs model compute. The multi-window alerts reduce alert fatigue while preserving signal for real regressions.

Checklist: - [x] Add metrics instrumentation (pkg/serving/kv_metrics.go) - [x] Add tracing spans and local tests (pkg/serving/kv_tracing.go) - [x] Add Grafana dashboard (observability/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.json) - [x] Add alert rules (slo/alerts/token_kv_alerts.yaml) - [x] Update docs (docs/observability/token-kv-dashboard.md) - [x] Run CI and manual validation using canary cluster - [x] Post-deploy monitoring for 48h

Rollout notes: Dashboard version v1.2. Will be deployed to staging then rolled to hosted monitors. Alert rules are gated behind a feature flag in terraform/monitoring/dashboards.tf to allow quick rollback. For Dedicated customers, configuration will be delivered in the next config bundle and feature-flag toggled by account upon agreement.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice consolidation. Two requests: (1) make the per-route label optional to limit label cardinality; (2) add an example alert suppression window in the runbook.
Priya Menon: Responded - added route label truncation for high-cardinality routes (see kv_metrics.go) and expanded runbook with suppression window example.
Maya Chen: CI flaked on dashboard lint (image panel json), I pushed a fix to normalize panel IDs. Also suggested minor wording changes in docs.
Roberto Alvarez: Approved after confirming the multi-window alert uses count aggregation and a 15m sustained threshold. Verified tracing spans attach request_id and route tags.
Liam O'Connor: Verified in staging: KV miss correlated with token tail latency in the canary trace. LGTM.
CI: initial run failed on lint (dashboard schema) - fixed in second commit, final CI passed.
Release lead (Maya Chen): Merged to main via squash after 48h monitoring on staging and no regressions observed.
release_notes: Add token-KV observability: new metrics (kv_lookup_total, kv_hit_total, kv_miss_total) with per-model and per-route labels, tracing spans for KV path, Grafana dashboard v1.2 (token cost/latency + KV heatmaps), and tuned multi-window alert rules to reduce noise. Recommended next steps: enable feature flag in production accounts and monitor for 72h.
